hookups.source: ReserveAmerica per-site catalog for parkId 880155 (all 17 Rustic Electric sites list 50-amp; no water or sewer hookups listed), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 31 drive-in RV/trailer sites on the booking site (17 Rustic Electric, 14 Rustic Non-Electric) besides 3 tent, 3 walk-to sites, lean-tos and group tenting; DCNR counts '34 tent and trailer campsites'. Non-electric sites take only 15-20 ft; electric sites run 20-40 ft (14 take 23 ft or more). Every site is back-in.

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/poe-paddy-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880155 (site list and each site's details page: Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Showers (for a fee) and the sanitary dump station are at nearby Poe Valley State Park, which also handles Poe Paddy's information.

facilities.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/poe-paddy-state-park/stay ('The Poe Paddy Campground has non-flush toilets and drinking water. Campers can use the sanitary dump station at nearby Poe Valley State Park. For a fee, campers can use the showers at Poe Valley State Park.'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Campsites can be booked for the same day and up to 11 months ahead (ReserveAmerica booking window).

booking.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/poe-paddy-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880155 ('Rustic Electric ... Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance', same for Rustic Non-Electric), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed the inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window and the mid-April to mid-December season (already manual). Added 50-amp at the 17 electric sites, 31 back-in RV sites to 40 ft, non-flush toilets and drinking water, no showers or dump on site (both at Poe Valley SP). Not stated: min/max stay, cutoff, walk-up. Fees left at the statewide rustic table.
flags: Missing official website: website holds only the ReserveAmerica link; add the DCNR park page https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/poe-paddy-state-park.
